SUPPORT / COMMON ERRORS

Find the failing part of the connection.

Start locally, then check the tunnel, then ChatGPT discovery. Each successful step narrows the problem.

OpenMausBot is unreachable

Open the app and check the actual local port. Set OPENMAUSBOT_URL to its explicit loopback origin. Only trusted local HTTP origins are accepted. The bridge does not discover ports automatically.

mcp-server.js is missing

The installed app may be in a nonstandard directory. Set OPENMAUSBOT_MCP_SCRIPT to the actual installed vendor script. Do not download a replacement script from an untrusted source.

Node.js is not found

Install Node.js from its official distribution and reopen your terminal or MCP client so it sees the updated PATH.

“Tool disabled by bridge policy”

Read tools are available by default. For actions, explicitly add --allow-writes after bridge.py or use start.ps1 -AllowWrites. Restart the connection and refresh discovery. Unknown tools remain blocked.

An action returns 403

The app may require a paired session token. Obtain it through OpenMausBot's supported pairing flow and inject OPENMAUSBOT_TOKEN into the launch environment. Action opt-in does not bypass app pairing. Do not extract application credential files.

Local tests pass, but ChatGPT cannot discover tools

Run tunnel doctor. Confirm the runtime key's permissions, intended organization, workspace association, correct stdio command, and a running client. If paths contain backslashes, use forward slashes in the tunnel command.

The live schema test fails after an update

The integration test deliberately detects upstream tool changes. Review the vendor's schemas and release changes before updating the allowlist. Do not blindly expose new capabilities.

The terminal appears idle

A manually started stdio server waits for an MCP client on stdin. An idle terminal is normal. Your local client or tunnel should launch the bridge itself.

Still blocked? Open a GitHub issue with app/Python versions and a redacted error message. Exclude API keys, private transcripts, tokens, and full diagnostic logs.
